svg.text: System Blueprint — Anti-Spoofing Login with Edge Liveness Detection on Raspberry Pi 5
ONNX Runtime, INT8 model on Pi
Attempt logs: decision, score, model ver.
Data drift: PSI on quality & score features
Concept drift: APCER / BPCER on audit
deploy model package vX.Y (ONNX INT8 + threshold config) via GitHub Release
③ signed result (decision, score, model version)
⑥ retraining trigger (monthly, performance drop or drift) → add new consented data, retrain, re-evaluate, redeploy
■ GitHub: code, configs, PR review, release tags
■ GitHub Actions: lint, unit tests, eval gate, release build
